text:
deploy-bot: Starting quiet-window readiness check for 'orbit' launch (2026-04-01 02:00 UTC). Prereqs: pin approval, rollback runbook, smoke green. Reply +1 when ready. Changelist: PR#4829 (kv-cache), PR#4830 (redis bump) :rocket:
maria: Quick status — release notes drafted, canary flag set to `orbit_beta`, docs link ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2.14.0-rc2
sahil: +1 on release notes. Verified no blocking migrations. Can we confirm DB read replicas are on the new patch?
jen: Confirmed replicas on patch schedule, no schema changes. I'll hold monitoring dashboards.
maria: Pin request — target artifact: inference-api:v2.14.0-rc2. Command to pin (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood.internal/pin \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"service":"inference-api","version":"v2.14.0-rc2","scope":"canary"}'
```
sahil: I ran the pin in staging earlier, smoke passed. +1 to pin in prod canary now.
oncall-bot: Smoke check started against canary nodes (3 regions). Running smoke suite: health, embeddings, bulk-infer. ETA ~90s.
oncall-bot: Smoke results: 4/4 checks passed. Avg p95 latency 120ms, error rate 0.02% (< threshold 0.5%). Logs: https://perf.redwood.ai/quiet/orbit-smoke
jen: Canary funnel: 10% traffic, 15m window. My plan: watch error-rate, client errors, kv cache hit ratio. If any metric breaches, call rollback.
maria: Rollback playbook (TL;DR): if 5xx spike >0.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 > 600ms for 5m -> run `deploy rollback inference-api v2.13.9`, repin previous, notify #incidents and paging. Escalation: oncall -> infra lead.
sahil: Noted. Quick check — feature flag `use_kv_cache_v2` is off for 90% traffic; will enable only for orbit_beta.
jen: +1 monitoring hooks in place. I added a grafana panel with alerts: `canary_5xx_rate > 0.5% for 3m` and `canary_p95 > 600ms for 5m`.
maria: Final ask: product to confirm marketing freeze lifted? marketing already greenlit quiet launch content.
jen: marketing confirmed. release-notes channel updated.
sahil: I'm watching logs. If anything odd, I will post the short-format rollback command: `deploy rollback inference-api v2.13.9 --reason "canary spike"`
jen: small note — if we rollback, we should roll feature flag back first, then rollback binary. Keeps consistent state.
oncall-bot: Canary promotion: started rollout to 10% traffic (inference-api:v2.14.0-rc2).
maria: +1 from me, proceeding with canary.
deploy-bot: Deploy started for inference-api:v2.14.0-rc2 (canary). Initiated at 2026-04-01T02:00:57Z.
oncall-bot: Canary health check (5m): healthy. error_rate 0.03%, latency p95 130ms.
sahil: Observed small spike at t+2m, traced to a downstream redis timeout, mitigated by routing fallback. No action needed.
jen: Monitoring steady. Holding for the rest of the window.
maria: If green at 15m, plan to promote to 50% then 100% in staged steps.
oncall-bot: Canary window complete (15m). Status: PASS. Promoting according to rollout policy.
deploy-bot: Promotion started -> 50% traffic.
jen: I'll keep an eye on the top 5 customers flagged for orbit_beta.
sahil: All good from infra side. Ready to finalize release notes and tag release.
maria: Done. Tagging release: v2.14.0. Small post-launch ops: keep thread for 1h for any fallout.
deploy-bot: Deployment finished: inference-api:v2.14.0 promoted to 100% at 2026-04-01T02:32:09Z. :tada:
